text: UP election is going to be a big deal, but it will be totally dependent upon UGC vs UCC. Look, Amit Shani announced that if BJP wins the UP election, then he will get a single code in the country. Some are calling it a masterstroke while some are confused. What was the need for UCC? Actually, it was the need for UCC because BJP has done a political blend of UCC regulation. It is going to be used to counter it. BJP's core waterbase is also largely a powercast category, which is a general category. And since Rahul Gandhi has been constantly targeting BJP with the demand for car census, BJP has impressed the UGC regulation through SCS in OVC communities through SCS in OVC. But what happened is that BJP's core waterbase has been against it. UGC regulation has now taken the Supreme Court, but BJP has now been in a political dilemma. If the UGC regulation is diluted with draw or dilute, then SCS in OVC communities can be backlashed. And if the regulation continues, without addressing the concerns of the general category, then the general category is not the first. To counter this political dilemma, we have brought the UCC to the US. So that BJP can fight the UP election on the basis of the Hindu unity. The USCC's biggest political opposition is the Muslim community. Because the Hindu's personal laws are already quite codified under the Hindu court bills, which govern matters like marriage, divorce, inheritance and adoption. So now everything totally depends upon the U.P. People's political strategy is what they see. Because the U.P election is going to be the crucial semi-final for the 2029 Lok Sabha election.
